title: Update AppRoot with folder gating
description: Modify CookbookApp/AppRoot.swift to observe RecipesFolderStore and branch on folderURL: when nil, render FolderSetupView full-screen (no TabView, no visible tab bar, Settings unreachable); when non-nil, render the existing TabView shell. Instantiate RecipesFolderStore at this level and inject it into the environment so SettingsView, RecipesTab, and FolderSetupView all share the same instance.
acceptance_criteria: AppRoot.swift renders FolderSetupView (not TabView) when RecipesFolderStore.folderURL is nil
AppRoot.swift renders TabView when RecipesFolderStore.folderURL is non-nil
Tab bar is NOT visible in the no-folder state
Settings sheet is unreachable in the no-folder state
After folder selection in FolderSetupView, AppRoot transitions to tab shell on next render without manual navigation
RecipesFolderStore is instantiated once at AppRoot and provided via .environment

handoff_summary.completed: AppRoot.swift modified: @State store ownership, folderURL-based branching, .environment(store) injection, FolderSetupView shown when no folder (no tab bar, Settings unreachable), TabView shown when folder is set, automatic transition on folder selection.
handoff_summary.remaining: Pre-existing build failure in RecipesFolderStore.swift: .withSecurityScope is unavailable on iOS (macOS-only API). This was introduced by a dependency bead and is outside this bead's scope.
handoff_summary.risks: RecipesFolderStore.swift uses .withSecurityScope which is unavailable on iOS — the project does not compile against iOS Simulator target until that dependency bead is corrected. AppRoot.swift changes are syntactically and semantically correct; the failure is entirely pre-existing and isolated to the dependency.
handoff_summary.next_action: Corrective bead needed on RecipesFolderStore.swift to replace .withSecurityScope with iOS-compatible bare bookmark APIs (URL.bookmarkData() without options, URL(resolvingBookmarkData:options:[]) without .withSecurityScope). See memory feedback_ios_security_scoped_bookmarks.md for context.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipesFolderStore.swift is a shared dependency; any corrective bead touching it should be aware that AppRoot, SettingsView, FolderSetupView, and RecipesTab all depend on the store's folderURL property remaining observable.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used Group { if/else } + .environment(store) on the Group rather than two separate .environment calls, so the store is available in both branches including FolderSetupView (even though it uses constructor injection, no harm in also having it in the environment for future use). @State ownership is correct for @Observable objects in SwiftUI — property changes to folderURL are tracked automatically in body.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Test coverage should verify: (1) AppRoot renders FolderSetupView when folderURL is nil, (2) AppRoot renders TabView when folderURL is non-nil, (3) transition fires without manual navigation after folder selection.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Project currently does not build against iOS Simulator due to pre-existing .withSecurityScope usage in RecipesFolderStore.swift. This is unrelated to AppRoot changes.

conflict_risks: RecipesFolderStore.swift is a shared dependency; any corrective bead touching it should be aware that AppRoot, SettingsView, FolderSetupView, and RecipesTab all depend on the store's folderURL property remaining observable.

execution_history.summary: Updated AppRoot.swift to instantiate RecipesFolderStore once with @State, branch on folderURL (nil → FolderSetupView full-screen, non-nil → TabView), and inject the store via .environment(store) so all descendants share the same instance. Transition from setup to tab shell is automatic via @Observable property tracking.
